_about: Rendered re-measurement of the calendar + composer over the RUNNING app. Captured 2026-10-30 by docs/audit/2026-10-30-launches-parity/probe-audit-render.mjs. Every number below is a getBoundingClientRect() or getComputedStyle() read, not an estimate. These are the numbers the 6 CORRECTION rows in PLAN_UI_PARITY_LAUNCHES_CALENDAR_2026-10-30.md are built on.

setup.seeded: 8 posts on the x integration with two tags, today, 08:00-16:55

1_preview_below_lg.old_claim: preview column is width 0 / absent below lg
1_preview_below_lg.verdict: collapseable, not deleted. The defect is the DEFAULT (off), not the mechanism.

2_composer_shell.old_claim: full-viewport, fills the screen, no page context
2_composer_shell.verdict: geometry already matches postiz's max-w-[1400px]. It is the 0.7-alpha scrim that removes context.

3_chip_has_time.old_claim: no time shown on the chip
3_chip_has_time.verdict: the time is the first element on the chip. The plan's 'add the time' is a no-op.

4_chip_has_tag_colour.old_claim: no tag colour on the chip
4_chip_has_tag_colour.verdict: a 3px bar and solid inkOnFill tag chips already exist. The plan's 'add a 1px left colour bar' is a no-op.

5_chip_has_hover_actions.old_claim: no hover actions on the chip

measured.chip_content_on_hover: opacity 0, sibling actions take its place, no overlap

6_chip_font_size.verdict: 11px, not 16px. The 21px height IS a real WCAG 2.2 2.5.8 FAIL.

F1_week_day_chip_21px.note: month already has .event-chip.compact { min-height: 24px } with the comment explaining the 24px floor; the non-compact chip was never given the same rule

F4_header_chrome.postiz: one flex-wrap gap-[8px] row, h-[42px] + 20px page padding

measured.verdict: both filled, neither is the primary

measured.railEntries: Channels (/channels) and Settings (/settings) as two rail links

F7_compose_stack.note: the content body - the tallest block - sits seventh of seven cards

measured.emptyCopy: Select a channel to see a preview. Every selected channel gets its own frame, in its own chrome.

F9_composer_heading_levels.note: no skipped level in practice; the ariaLabel 'Composer' names the dialog (AGENTS.md 9.49)

askClose + Draft saved + Cmd+Enter / Cmd+S hints (postiz has none)

providerInk / OnCard / OnChip / OnInput - 4.5:1 on four surfaces
